# Qt 6.11.2 third-party attribution notices

These original HTML pages were copied from the official Qt 6.11.2 documentation. They preserve the upstream component descriptions, copyright notices, license texts, and documentation notices.

The collection covers the upstream sections for Qt Core, GUI, Network, SVG, and Image Formats. These correspond to the Qt libraries and image format plugins bundled with the Windows app. Qt Widgets has no separate section in this upstream index. The collection is deliberately inclusive: it also preserves notices for optional or other-platform components in those sections; inclusion does not assert they are active in this build.

The original index is saved as `upstream-index.html`. Its links to modules outside the collected sections remain upstream references. Individual saved pages below contain the notices. They can be opened locally; their content does not require the upstream site styles.

The additional Mesa llvmpipe and LLVM attribution pages preserve upstream notices for software OpenGL. The bundled `PySide6/opengl32sw.dll` identifies itself as Mesa 11.2.2. The LLVM page also describes Qt's development tools; those descriptions do not imply that qdoc or lupdate is distributed with this application.

The Qt documentation footer identifies the GNU Free Documentation License 1.3. That text is retained at `../Qt-PySide-6.11.2-upstream/GFDL-1.3-no-invariants-only.txt`. Third-party software notices keep their individual license terms. The parent `manifest.json` records original URLs and SHA-256 checksums for the unmodified HTML files.
